def slug(text):
    # Convert to lowercase and replace all non-alphanumeric characters with hyphens
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]', '-', text.lower())
    # Replace sequences of hyphens with a single hyphen

def slug(text):
    # Replace all non-ASCII letters and non-digits with hyphen
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-zA-Z0-9]', '-', text)
    # Convert to lowercase
    s = s.lower()
    # Replace sequences of hyphens with a single hyphen
    s = re.sub(r'--+', '-', s)
    # Trim leading and trailing hyphens

import re

def slug(text):
    def replace_char(match):
        char = match.group(0)
        # Check if the character is an ASCII letter
        if char.isalpha() and char.isascii():
            return char.lower()
        # Check if the character is a digit
        elif char.isdigit():
            return char
        # Otherwise, replace with a hyphen
        else:
            return '-'

    # Step 1: Replace each character with the appropriate value
    processed = re.sub(r'(.|\n)', replace_char, text)

    # Step 2: Replace runs of hyphens with a single hyphen
    processed = re.sub(r'-+', '-', processed)

    # Step 3: Trim leading and trailing hyphens
    processed = processed.strip('-')

    return processed
